Posterior draws of population parameters

Source: R/fit.R
bpk_draws.Rd

Posterior draws of population parameters

Usage

bpk_draws(x)

Arguments

x

A bpk_fit.

Value

A draws_df (posterior package) with typical values on the natural scale, estimated covariate effects, standard deviations of between-subject variability (log scale), correlations and residual error.

Examples

# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("nlmixr2data", quietly = TRUE)) {
d <- nlmixr2data::theo_sd
mod <- pk_model("1cmt", route = "oral", iiv = c("CL", "V", "KA"))
fit <- bpk_fit(mod, d, chains = 2, iter = 1000, seed = 1)
head(posterior::as_draws_df(bpk_draws(fit)))
}
